reason: The Basement Clinic billed them for family therapy they never attended. Mayor Raven holds the eviction AND the invoice. They collect coping evidence — violence as homework — so the clinic does not seize the apartment or the Son's tutoring license.

film1.text: RAVEN WHARF. NIGHT. THE BASEMENT CLINIC STILL HAS THE LIGHTS ON.
They billed us for a session we skipped. That's not a metaphor.
I was networking. In the alley. With my feelings.
MAYOR RAVEN HOLDS THE EVICTION. AND THE INVOICE. SAME CLIPBOARD.

comics.title: PAST DUE
comics.text: FAMILY THERAPY × 12. NOBODY SAT DOWN. THE COUCH STILL CHARGED RENT.

comics.title: THE FATHER
comics.text: I DIDN'T EVEN TAKE OFF MY SHOES.

comics.title: THE SON
comics.text: YOU NEVER DO. THAT'S THE INVOICE.

film2.text: HOMEWORK: COLLECT COPING EVIDENCE. FILE IT IN BLOOD.
If we file this, I keep the tutoring license. You keep the fridge.
That's called a parenting win. Come on.
DOCK STREET IS STILL HIRING. THEY LIE ABOUT THAT.

dock_street->intake_lot.title: THE INTAKE LOT
dock_street->intake_lot.sub: Coping hour. The magnet is the love language.

lines.text: We filed Dock Street. The lot is the waiting list with teeth.
I validate parking. Then I park on the feeling.
EIGHTY-EIGHT SECONDS. ELITES AT THIRTY-TWO. NOBODY GETS A TICKET OUT.

intake_lot->fire_escapes.title: THE FIRE ESCAPES
intake_lot->fire_escapes.sub: Roofs after the lot. Gaps with opinions.

lines.text: My knees filed a complaint. The roofs did not stamp it.
Glide. Don't speech. The vendor already priced your name.
VERTICAL ALIBI. THE STREET STILL BITES UNDER THE POETRY.
They're going to pass a stick. Don't take it.
I pass. That's growth. That's also a kidney stone.
THE FACILITATOR HEARS YOU. THEN HE BILLS YOU.

group_circle->neon_exchange.title: NEON EXCHANGE
group_circle->neon_exchange.sub: Agents tax the smile. Pawn keeps the plate.

lines.text: I smiled in 2009. I'm still paying interest.
Cash the feelings before they pawn your pulse.
WARRANT LIGHT. BOARD OR PISTOL. SHARING IS A WEAPON.

neon_exchange->waiting_room.title: THE WAITING ROOM
neon_exchange->waiting_room.sub: Fluorescent forever. Don't sit. The dog was already here.

lines.text: Is that a skinwalker?
THAT is a skinwalker.
I asked a hundred times. Those photos were trash. This one isn't.
THEY WERE NOT ALWAYS THIS VISIBLE. THE SKIPPED SESSION TORE THE WAITING LIST. FILE IT.
Bots don't blink. I respect the work ethic.
You blinked in 2011 and called it a sabbatical.
BOXCARS ARE ROOFS. THE RECEIPT IS A GRENADE.
Deputy first. Mayor later. That's called pacing.
I don't pace. I loom. If I lose, we get a note on the door.
STATUES CLIMB. RAVEN DOES NOT SHARE THE MORTGAGE.

city_hall->copay_orchard.title: COPAY ORCHARD
city_hall->copay_orchard.sub: The wellness weekend they never booked.

lines.text: They billed a retreat. We never sat on the hay.
I networked. With a scarecrow. It had better posture.
LAKE. FOREST. FIELDS. A SILO WITH A ROPE. THE COPAY HAS TREES.

copay_orchard->sleet_hour.title: SLEET HOUR
copay_orchard->sleet_hour.sub: The orchard froze. Hold the lake.

lines.text: I packed a polo. The weather packed a personality.
Don't sit on the ice. Sitting is how they win. Again.
SNOWMOBILES. ICE WIRES. EIGHTY-EIGHT SECONDS OF COPAY SLEET.

sleet_hour->raven_grid.title: RAVEN GRID
sleet_hour->raven_grid.sub: Cyberpunk downtown. Steal the lemon courier.

lines.text: You drive. I shoot three-sixty. Do not hit a scooter and call it growth.
I am on the rail. If I network with a lamppost, bill me.
NOT A MIL TRUCK. A CLINIC COURIER. RAMP. CANAL. THE CRASH IS THE BOSS INTRO.

raven_grid->ledger_dive.title: LEDGER DIVE
raven_grid->ledger_dive.sub: The drop. A spa they billed as therapy.

lines.text: We fell into the vault. The ads are drowning. That's the surprise.
I hate spas. I hate brine. I can still punch an eel.
FLOODED LEDGER. BILLBOARD CENOTE. HOLD THE HOUR. THEN THE PIER.

ledger_dive->invoice_pier.title: INVOICE PIER
ledger_dive->invoice_pier.sub: The annex. Not Dock Street with a cold.

lines.text: The vault spat us at the water. Splint still has the original invoice.
I hate chapels. I hate being right. I can web a crane.
DR. SPLINT HAS THE CLIPBOARD. THE COPAY IS A NAVE.

invoice_pier->processing_floor.title: THE PROCESSING FLOOR
invoice_pier->processing_floor.sub: Late act. Strip the suit. Then the body.

lines.text: Splint was middle management. The Director wears the bill.
If it's huge, I web the knee. If it has plates, I eat the plates.
Bandage first. That's enabling. Do it anyway.
FILE ALIVE if it stuns. Extra gold. Huntdown called it a bounty. We call it parenting.
THE FAMILY PLAN IS NOT THE MAYOR. THE FAMILY PLAN IS THE NIGHT.

ending.title: THE FRIDGE STAYS
ending.sub: The invoice is a corpse. Homework is over.

lines.text: THE PROCESSING FLOOR GOES DARK. THE CLIPBOARD STOPS TICKING.
Tutoring license: still mine. Apartment: still a crime scene with a lease.
I networked. In the basement. With a billing mech. LinkedIn can wait.
We skipped twelve sessions. We filed the Director. That's not growth. That's a refund.
Come on. The fridge stays. I believe in us. Briefly.
RAVEN WHARF KEEPS THE LIGHTS ON. THE BASEMENT CLINIC DOES NOT. END OF NIGHT.

tutorial_alley.title: TUTORIAL ALLEY
tutorial_alley.main: Learn the three languages: jump, gun, punch. Then lie about growth.
tutorial_alley.side: Hit the dummy like it billed you.

lines.text: Jump. Punch. Don't make it a personality.
I have a personality. It's unemployed.

dock_street.title: DOCK STREET
dock_street.main: Pull the first stack of coping evidence off Dock Street before the clinic posts it on the door.
dock_street.side: Smash a crate. That's a feeling with a lid.

lines.text: If anyone asks, this is homework.
If anyone asks, you're the assignment.
Roofs. Gaps. Try not to make a speech.
I was going to say I believe in us.
Gun stretch. I brought a personality and three bullets.
Two of those are imaginary.

intake_lot.title: THE INTAKE LOT
intake_lot.main: Hold the flooded car park for a coping hour. Elites come in packs. The magnet is the love language.
intake_lot.side: Vacuum eight experience chips. The clinic calls them insights.

lines.text: This is the waiting list. It bites.
I validate the horde. Then I park on it.

fire_escapes.title: THE FIRE ESCAPES
fire_escapes.main: Cross the roofs and file a vertical alibi before the vendor sells your name.
fire_escapes.side: Buy a second opinion. Or steal the silence.

lines.text: Gaps. Glide. If you fall, make it a joke.
My joints already filed a complaint.
Street still bites under the poetry.
That's the brawl section. Try punching it.

group_circle.title: GROUP CIRCLE
group_circle.main: Survive the courtyard share. Nobody passes the talking stick. Everybody brings a chair.
group_circle.side: Let the magnet do the processing.

lines.text: I pass. That's growth.
You pass like a kidney stone.

boss.title: The Facilitator
boss.sub: WE HEAR YOU. WE BILL YOU.

neon_exchange.title: NEON EXCHANGE
neon_exchange.main: Cash the feelings before the agents pawn your pulse.
neon_exchange.side: Pick up a board or a pistol. Sharing is a weapon.

lines.text: Smile. Agents tax that.
I smiled in 2009. I'm still paying interest.
Pawn & Plate. Sell the pipe, keep the wound.
That's the mission statement.

waiting_room.title: THE WAITING ROOM
waiting_room.main: Hold the fluorescent forever-room. Number 87 is already sitting. Unmask it. FILE it. Numbers skip you on purpose.
waiting_room.side: Don't sit. The dog was already here. That's how they win.

lines.text: We're number 88. There is no 87.
Then why is that dog already on the chair.

rail_bridge.title: RAIL BRIDGE
rail_bridge.main: Pay the toll in personality. Keep a grenade as a receipt.
rail_bridge.side: Ride a boxcar roof. The street still bites.

lines.text: Bots don't blink. I respect the work ethic.
You blinked in 2011 and called it a sabbatical.

city_hall.title: CITY HALL
city_hall.main: Climb the statues. The landlord has throwing stars and a mortgage on your name.
city_hall.side: Put the Deputy on the floor. Then the Mayor.

lines.text: Deputy first. Mayor later. That's called pacing.
I don't pace. I loom.
If I lose, we get a nice note on the door.
If you win, we still get the invoice.

copay_orchard.title: COPAY ORCHARD
copay_orchard.main: File the wellness weekend they never booked. Lake, forest, fields, a silo with a rope.
copay_orchard.side: Slide the hill. Rope-swing the silo. Don't tip the scarecrow.

lines.text: They billed a retreat. Hay is not a couch.
I networked. With corn. It had better eye contact.
Rope. I can still swing. Unemployment taught me that.
Land it. The lake still wants a copay.

sleet_hour.title: SLEET HOUR
sleet_hour.main: Hold the frozen lake. Snowmobiles at the elite pack. Don't sit.
sleet_hour.side: Magnet the chips off the ice. The retreat froze on purpose.

lines.text: Don't sit. The ice is a waiting room with weather.
I packed a polo. That's on me.

raven_grid.title: RAVEN GRID
raven_grid.main: Steal the lemon clinic courier. One drives. One rails 360°. Forced ramp. Crash the canal. The crash is the boss intro.
raven_grid.side: Vault a scooter. Don't hug the grid car. Don't brake on the ramp.

lines.text: Cyberpunk. Not Dock Street with extra pink.
I can still drive. LinkedIn called it a transferable skill.
You drive. I shoot. Do not network with a lamppost.
I am on the rail. That's called coparenting.

ledger_dive.title: LEDGER DIVE
ledger_dive.main: Hold the flooded vault. A spa they billed as therapy. Billboards drown. Then the pier.
ledger_dive.side: Rope the brine. Don't sit in the cenote.

lines.text: We dropped into the ledger. The ads are drowning. That's the surprise.
I hate spas. I can still punch an eel.

invoice_pier.title: INVOICE PIER
invoice_pier.main: Walk the flooded annex. File the original invoice on Dr. Splint's desk. Or his ribs.
invoice_pier.side: Crack a chapel crate. That's the copay.

lines.text: This is not Dock Street with a cold. This is the annex.
I hate water. I hate chapels. I hate being right.
Cranes. I can web that. I can also drown with style.
Parkour first. Therapy never.
Chapel doors. Ushers. Don't tip.
I was going to tithe a punch.

processing_floor.title: THE PROCESSING FLOOR
processing_floor.main: Strip Director Binder's armor. Survive the patterns. File The Family Plan. Then go home.
processing_floor.side: Buy the bandage. SNAP him ALIVE when he stuns for extra gold.

lines.text: This is the late act. Not the Mayor again. The suit comes off first.
I brought a personality and a web. He brought four plates.
Lights bounce. Heavies strip. I have been waiting my whole unemployment for this sentence.
If you SNAP too early I will bill you myself.
